name: print-social-future-belongs-to-leaders-post-with-low-poly-green-handshake
title: 'The Future Belongs to Leaders' post with a glowing low-poly green handshake
whatItIs: A portrait near-black post with a green bar logo, white 'The Future' over huge neon green 'Belongs Leaders' with a small blue 'to' circle, a wireframe low-poly handshake glowing green, and white and green button bars ('Learn Project Management with Google', 'Send a DM to Signup Now!').
whatItMeans: Techy and aspirational; the digital handshake symbolises partnership in a data-driven future.
techniques: Render a symbol as glowing low-poly wireframe.
Tuck a tiny connector word into a circle.
Use one neon hue on near-black.

vocabulary.definition: 3D style built from visible flat triangles.
An object drawn as its outline edges.
